=== Standalone installation and upgrade

- Fixed an issue where a Standalone installation or upgrade was reported as failed with the message `One or more HelmReleases failed to reconcile`, even though the deployment completed successfully. Because the run stopped early, the environment also continued to report the previous Kobiton version. Installations and upgrades now wait for all services to become ready before reporting a result.
- Installations and upgrades now report a failure when a service does not become ready within the wait period. The failure names each affected service and its status message. Previously, a run could finish without an error while a service was still not ready.
